blockers.summary: Required GitHub Actions jobs abort before executing because account payments failed or the Actions spending limit must be increased. No implementation merge while required checks cannot run.

Production correctly fails closed without APP_STORE_ISSUER_ID, APP_STORE_KEY_ID, and APP_STORE_PRIVATE_KEY. Keep the last successful deployment live until real credentials exist and the candidate SHA is verified.
Release acceptance still requires private release configuration, current domain/privacy proof, physical-device/provider checks, and human TestFlight smoke signoff.
